name: m4-asf-kperf
description: PMU profile (cycles, instructions) through the kperf helper, scala corpus, one fork per build, for the `asSeenFrom(C.this, C)` fast path (`PROPOSAL-asseenfrom.md`, branch `claude/asseenfrom-fastpath-d7ef00`). The JIT pilot `m4-asf-jit` could not resolve the timing gap against its A/A; instruction counts in the `asSeenFrom` / `AsSeenFromMap` inclusive frames give the evidence instead. Not a timing A/B.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, as `m4-int00e3bb-kperf-l1d`.
